rules.aggregation: Equal mean of all four registered native times within each query, then equal mean of all32 queries. No selected times/layers/queries.
rules.support: All four EEG paired contrasts and correct-versus-wrong-F full-UNet epsilon contrast strictly positive; no near-zero teacher entries.
rules.not_supported: All four EEG paired contrasts strictly negative while correct-versus-wrong-F epsilon contrast strictly positive; no near-zero teacher entries.
rules.otherwise: UNKNOWN; includes conflicts, exact ties, non-supportive teacher epsilon comparison, or any near-zero teacher entry.

numerical_consistency_only.source: Existing diagnostic numerical consistency checks at lines176-178; never an effect-size threshold.

guard_order: Successful complete main terminal plus dead PID; otherwise no diagnostic result read.
Successful diagnostic queue and wrapper terminals plus dead actual PIDs; otherwise no raw/summary read.
All six diagnostic artifacts must exist; missing results refuse before result payload reads.
Fresh source/metadata SHA, actual full32 identities/OOF/negative mapping, artifact closure and numerical checks.
All32 equal four-time means and fixed descriptive direction policy; no review/admission booleans.
Recheck terminal file hashes and PID liveness; preserve earlier outputs.
known_scope_limits: No practical effect size or inferential significance is registered; positive directions do not establish a useful-sized effect.
No image benefit or reconstruction performance is measured; no teacher self-J or self-MSE utility claim.
Missing-reference Q, old negative bijection and DDPM-real-latent probes differ from v2 parent-Q training and actual Euler sampling.
Any near-zero teacher item leaves exact masked-v2 correspondence unknown because joint query-by-layer data were not saved.
